Under the new efficiency scheme, J. Holder leads with 86.2 per cent, having jumped 20ft. 0½in. on June 13th; G.

A notable feature of the racing was the smallness of the fields, and it looked as if our members had had a surfeit of racing events and so were disinclined to support our final meeting. Jack Holder won the Sprint in fast time off 6½ yards and displayed fine dash for so late in the season.

Last year's holder, Jack Holder, has done nothing of note this season in the jumping line, and so we trust that the question of who is to be the new holder will be settled at a meeting of mathematical experts presided over by our friend, Ken O'Kell.
